monitoring.acceptAll.confirmMessage:
Accept {pending} pending online ballot(s) now?

This creates regular ballots as if a teller typed them from paper, then wipes the online vote content. It cannot be undone. Those voters will not be able to change those votes.

Online voting can stay open. Only ballots that are pending right now are accepted. You can run Accept all again later for any new pending ballots.
monitoring.acceptAll.finalized: Cannot accept online ballots after the election is finalized.
monitoring.acceptAll.inProgress: Another Accept all is already running for this election.
monitoring.acceptAll.none: There are no pending online ballots to accept.
monitoring.acceptAll.nonePending: No pending online ballots to accept.
monitoring.onlineWindow.title: Closing
monitoring.connectedOnlineVoters.title: Connected online voters
monitoring.connectedOnlineVoters.note: Anonymous count of online voter sessions currently on this election's ballot page. Names are not shown. This is not a count of ballots being built — composing is not stored until submit.
monitoring.ballotsByMethod.title: Ballots by voting method
monitoring.ballotsByMethod.note: People counted by the method recorded at Front Desk. Online also includes accepted online ballots that have no other method. Counts only.
monitoring.onlineBallots.countsOnly: Counts only. Voter names are not shown.
